video_caption: The video shows a man with a shaved head and goatee standing next to a poster of Leland Slar playing a Warwick bass guitar, at the Warwick booth at the NAMM (National Association of Music Merchants) 2015 show, in Shibuya, Tokyo. The presenter is wearing a white T-shirt that says, "Ishi Bashi Music." A logo of a red circle containing a white musical note, and the phrase "ISHIBASHI MUSIC Shibuya, Tokyo" is displayed on the bottom of the screen. The presenter says the man in the poster is Leland Slar and explains that he has played in many bass sessions. Just then the camera pans to the right to show Leland Slar standing right next to the poster. Leland Slar is wearing a grey T-shirt, has long hair, and a long beard. He gestures to the poster, asking which one of them is real and joking that the poster version of him has more depth. He also mentions that he lost his wristband and can't get parking validation. The Warwick sign, including the phrase "Basses, Amps & Rock'n'Roll," can be seen at the top of the poster.
